(1) 'to the owner's left' (CH-CLIENT) and 'far end of the showroom' / 'far behind the phone' / 'far behind the people' give no distances or image side; say 'on the left side of the image'. (2) 'screen lit' with 'black glass front' does not say what colour the chat background is. FL-04 (empty or wrong story props): prevention needs the prop sheet attached and a content line; the sheet is 'to build' and unversioned, and the screen background is unspecified. FL-06 (faceless or blob anatomy in close-ups): named visible parts are good ('back of the head, back of the neck and collar visible') but the owner's turned head invites a profile. FL-13 (model-drawn logo) is handled: 'bottom-left corner (lowest 9% of the height, left 40% of the width) calm, dark and empty', 'no logo or wordmark drawn anywhere', logo-zone region [0.0, 0.91, 0.4, 1.0]. FL-05, FL-11 ('instances: 1', 'both feet flat on the floor') and FL-01 are handled.

suggested_spec_changes: must_read_in_1s: replace with one checkable moment, e.g. 'A lit phone showing two unanswered messages lies alone on the desk in the foreground while two people stand with their backs turned at the far end of the showroom.' If the owner must read as busy, the headline carries that, not the picture.

action_physics[1] and subjects CH-OWNER/CH-CLIENT: write distances, e.g. 'both stand about 1.5 m in front of the sample rack; the customer's head is bowed forward, his face about 40 cm from one door sample without touching it; the owner stands level with him, head and shoulders square to the rack.' Make PR-SAMPLE-RACK state 'directly behind the people, out of focus' instead of 'far behind the people'.

CH-OWNER, action_physics and background_action: drop 'the owner's head turned slightly toward it'; use 'the back of the owner's head squarely to the camera, only the back of the head, neck and collar visible, no cheek, ear-front or profile'.

must_not: replace 'no readable words on any phone screen except the strings listed in the text block or the props block' with 'no letters, words, digits or app names on the phone screen; the two bubbles hold only grey bars'.

PR-PHONE-SCREEN content: add the chat background, e.g. 'on a dark charcoal chat background, the incoming bubbles light grey, a faint warm glow on the desk around the phone'. Also state PR-PHONE case visibility: 'the deep red #BE0F18 case shows as a rim around the black glass front'.

PR-PHONE-SCREEN ref: build PS-CHAT on SS-LIB-W45W46, pass G-VIS-SHEET, then set ref to the versioned asset (e.g. 'PS-CHAT@v1 state CHAT-IN-2') and keep it as the last reference image. Set PR-PHONE story_critical true with the same ref (or a phone state on the sheet), since the red case is the thread.

CH-CLIENT state: change 'to the owner's left' to 'on the left side of the image, shoulder to shoulder with the owner'.
